I’m a Full Stack Developer with a stronger focus on Front-end development, currently studying Computer Science. I have experience working with React, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, REST APIs, and MongoDB.

I’m passionate about web development, technology, and building creative solutions that solve real-world problems. I enjoy collaborating with others, sharing knowledge, learning new technologies, and turning ideas into functional and engaging applications.
